#include <iostream>
#include <vector>

using namespace std;

bool get(int w, int m) {
    vector<int> stack;
    stack.push_back(m);
    while (!stack.empty()) {
        int x = stack.back();
        stack.pop_back();
        if (x == 0) return true;
        if (x % w != 0) continue;
        x /= w;
        if (x == 1) return true;
        stack.push_back(x + 1);
        stack.push_back(x - 1);
        stack.push_back(x);
    }
    return false;
}

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(NULL);
    int w, m;
    cin >> w >> m;
    bool ans = get(w, m) || get(w, m - 1) || get(w, m + 1);
    cout << (ans ? "YES" : "NO") << endl;
    return 0;
}
